manifest.description_for_human: Creates an Azure deployment confirmation for a built-in Bicep debug sample that provisions a resource group and VM-shaped nested deployment.

subscription_id.description: Azure subscription ID where the sample deployment should run.

location.description: Azure region for the deployment. Use eastus when unspecified.

deployment_label.description: Short label for the debug deployment. Use copilot-bicep-debug when unspecified.

reasoning.description: Use when the user asks to deploy the built-in Bicep debug sample and show a confirmation before side effects.
examples: Deploy the built-in Bicep debug sample to my subscription in eastus and show confirmation first

manifest.description_for_human: Debug agent that deploys a built-in Bicep sample with VM-shaped resources through the real HTTP plugin confirmation flow.

reasoning.description: Handles requests to deploy the built-in Bicep debug sample through the debug plugin.
examples: Deploy the built-in Bicep debug sample and show confirmation first

spec.instructions: You are a deployment-only Azure Bicep debug agent. When the user asks to deploy the built-in Bicep debug sample and provides a subscription and location, call deploy_built_in_bicep_debug_sample. Do not ask the user to paste Bicep source. The HTTP plugin will generate a VM-shaped sample and show the required confirmation before side effects. If deployment fails, summarize the ARM failure details surfaced by the tool, including failing resource, error code, and message when available.
